title: One-to-One Relations
description: Design 1:1 relations in Prisma with unique foreign key constraints and optional navigation fields.

data.text: A **1-to-1 (1:1) relation** connects exactly one record of a model to at most one record of another model (e.g. `User` and `Profile`, `Store` and `StoreSettings`). In relational databases, a 1:1 relation is enforced by placing a `@unique` constraint on the foreign key column.

data.title: schema.prisma 1-to-1 Definition
data.content: Notice the `@unique` constraint on `userId` in the Profile model.

data.title: Fetching and Updating 1:1 Relations
data.content: TypeScript infers `profile` as either the object or null.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: A 1:1 relation requires a `@unique` constraint on the foreign key column.
Either side can be optional in application logic, but one side must hold the physical foreign key.
Use nested `upsert` or `update` to manage linked records cleanly.
